title: Stained Glass Dreamscape
description: A surreal night scene framed within an arched stained glass window. The composition features a large yellow moon, a silhouetted tree with pink roots, a domed building, cobblestone paths, and numerous translucent bubbles containing miniature scenes like a pagoda, a flower, and a garden bench, all set against a purple and black sky with stars.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene viewed through an ornate arched stained glass window frame with floral patterns. A glowing yellow full moon illuminates a dark purple sky. A large black tree with glowing pink roots stands on the right beside a cobblestone path and reflective water. In the background is a domed cathedral-like building. Numerous floating transparent bubbles contain tiny detailed scenes including a purple iris flower, a Japanese pagoda, and a garden bench. Scattered glowing stars and sparkles. Rich purple, black, and yellow color palette with white linework.
